question: Secunderabad is the headquarters of which railway zone ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**South Central Railway Zone**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **South Central Railway Zone**

 
 
• **Established:** October 2, 1966
 
• **Headquarters:** Secunderabad, Telangana, India
 
• **Jurisdiction:** Covers parts of Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Maharashtra, and Karnataka.
 
• **Divisions:** Secunderabad, Hyderabad, Vijayawada, Guntakal, Guntur, and Nanded.
 
• **Focus:** Connects major cities, industrial areas, and tourist destinations within its region.
 
• **Key Role:** Plays a vital role in the economic and social development of the southern and central parts of India.
